posts.zh:
dsh-chat-index-rail 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-25d4d2792b599490d040.html
posts.en:
dsh-chat-index-rail is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-25d4d2792b599490d040.html
